open_questions: HUD gives planning lives for US multifamily housing; the municipal rows are Ontario accounting lives. Neither is observed replacement data.

A municipal minimum standard tied to the statutory defence in s.44 of the Municipal Act, 2001; patrolling is a drive-by observation of the whole road, not a component-level inspection. Not an official version.
